Priya (infra): Hey team — seeing weird residency drops on long chat sessions starting ~2026-03-04. Dashboards show residency p50/p95 collapsing from ~85% -> ~30% while token hit_rate stays ~stable. Any ideas?
Jonathan (runtime): Hmm, can you paste the query/alert? Do we rotate sampling shards on hour boundaries or on-demand? We have a sampler rotation job.
Priya (infra): Query excerpt: `sum by(shard) (kv_cache_residency_samples_total)` then percentiles from histogram buckets. Also saw eviction_counter spike coincident with sampler rotate. Log snippet: 
```
[info] sampler: rotated shard=5 -> shard=6 at 2026-03-04T22:00:01Z
[kv] eviction.count: 120
```
Sam (observability): That pattern screams "rotation resets state". Our dashboards aggregate raw counters across shards without a rotation_id label, so a rotation looks like a drop.
Anya (sre): I reproduced in staging using long-session generator. When rotation happens the residency gauge/summary is re-initialized and the percentiles jump around.
Jonathan (runtime): Two possibilities: 1) sampler process zeroes per-shard accumulators on rotation, 2) shard assignment changes and hot items move to a different collector which hasn't warmed.
Priya (infra): Quick mitigation idea: add `rotation_id` label to `kv_residency_samples_total` and `kv_evictions_total` so we can slice by rotation and use `max_over_time` to avoid mixing rotations.
Sam (observability): For dashboards we should: 1) expose rotation_id in the panel header, 2) change aggregated queries to `sum by(model,rotation_id)(...)` then `max_over_time(...[30m])` for continuity, 3) add a heatmap showing residency percentiles per-rotation.
Jonathan (runtime): Long-term fix: make sampler checkpoint state (persist cumulative sketches) to object store and resume without resetting counters; or switch to monotonic counters and never reset on rotation. Checkpointing also helps cross-host restarts.
Priya (infra): I'll open a small change to include rotation_id label and update one dashboard panel as a canary. If that reduces spurious drift we'll expand.
Anya (sre): Also add an alert: `kv_residency_p50_drop` when p50 drops >20% vs baseline for >10m with rotation_id unchanged. That avoids false positives during rotation.
Priya (infra): Filing ops ticket and PR: infra-bot: created issue #4887 `kv-telemetry-rotation` and draft PR https://git.redwood.internal/infra/kv-telemetry/pulls/12 — staging run scheduled 2026-03-10T03:00Z :white_check_mark:
Sam (observability): Nice. After staging run let's capture raw sampler logs + prometheus scrape snapshots so we can correlate rotation_id -> eviction spikes.
Jonathan (runtime): If staging confirms, I'll follow up with runtime change to persist sampler sketches.
Priya (infra): Thanks all — assigning follow-ups. @Anya please own on-call verification after staging. :+1:
Anya (sre): On it.
Priya (infra): Will post results here after the run.
